title: Clean DCP Dyadic Prefix-Peeling Reduction: Exact Truncation Uniformity, Incorrect-Prefix Character Depolarization, and Binomial Majority-Verifier Bounds

theorems.statement: When hat_p_k = s mod 2^k, writing s = hat_p_k + 2^k s^{(k)} and a = tilde_a + 2^{t-k} h_a (tilde_a = a mod 2^{t-k}, h_a = floor(a / 2^{t-k})) yields omega_{2^t}^{a(s - hat_p_k)} = omega_{2^{t-k}}^{tilde_a s^{(k)}} for every h_a in Z_{2^k}, so tilde_a is uniform on Z_{2^{t-k}} with fiber size 2^k and conditional state |psi_{tilde_a}(s^{(k)})> of pure visibility 1.

Whenever hat_p_k != s mod 2^k, delta = (s - hat_p_k) mod 2^t has 2-adic valuation v_2(delta) in {0, ..., k-1}, so averaging over unobserved high label bits h_a in Z_{2^k} gives bar{rho}_{tilde_a}(s, hat_p_k)[0, 1] = (1/2) omega_{2^t}^{-tilde_a delta} (2^{-k} sum_{h_a=0}^{2^k - 1} omega_{2^k}^{-h_a (delta mod 2^k)}) = 0. Thus bar{rho}_{tilde_a}(s, hat_p_k) = I_2 / 2 for every tilde_a in Z_{2^{t-k}} and all 2^k - 1 wrong prefixes.

For odd R = 2m + 1 invocations at advantage eps in (0, 1/2], exact majority error P_maj(R, eps) = sum_{j=0}^m C(R, j)(1/2+eps)^j(1/2-eps)^{R-j} <= (1 - 4 eps^2)^{R/2} <= exp(-2 R eps^2). For any candidate c != s mod 2^t of arbitrary 2-adic valuation v_2(s - c) in {0, ..., t-1}, the X-basis verifier has exact single-shot acceptance P_+(s, c) = 1/2 and L_ver-shot survival 2^{-L_ver}.
